caption: The drawing depicts a single standing female figure facing forward. She is dressed in a multilayered outfit that features a long, vertically striped apron-like outer garment in pink, tan, and beige tones over a blue and white patterned dress. Her sleeves are short, revealing her brown-skinned arms with blue armbands on the upper arms. Beneath the outer garment, the visible part of her dress includes a pale blue and white polka-dotted blouse and matching loose trousers. She wears blue shoes and a head covering made of a tan or beige lace-like material that is tied under her chin. The background is plain and unadorned, consisting of an off-white or light beige color. The composition is centered, with the figure standing upright and both arms resting by her sides.
title: Doll
